deduct_settings.title: Settings for: {sensor_name}
deduct_settings.description:
Set parameters for this manageable load device (sensor).

**Hint:** Set Required Energy to '0' if the device absorbs ANY available surplus energy without a fixed daily quota.
**Power (kW)** is used to strictly limit the device from running if current solar generation is less than consumption (preventing battery drain. 0 = ignore).
